name: Tamana
bio: Tamana was ordered by her Legion commanders to abandon barbarians in a losing fight. She refused – her unit of volunteers fought to save the souls of fallen Varkis, even at the cost of a Lightseeker artifact. She was stripped of rank, but not of pride, and now seeks to recover what she lost.

effects.label: RES Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Resistance stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: DEF Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Defense stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.
